property_summary: For any caller and amount, Collect should deduct exactly _am from the caller's balance whenever the caller has at least MinSum and at least _am; the mutant fails when the balance exactly equals MinSum or _am because it requires balances[msg.sender] > MinSum, leaving the caller's balance unchanged.
change_summary: Invert the guard by changing the balance condition from >= to >, so Collect no longer executes when balances[msg.sender] equals MinSum or _am.
